case_title.reason: Title matches the caption: Kamal v. State (NCT of Delhi).

number_of_accused.reason: Judgment refers to the original three accused convicted under s.302/34.

accused_gender.reason: Accused are described as male, e.g. the son Prem Singh and the other male accused.

accused_age.reason: No accused age is stated in the judgment.

accused_religion.reason: Religion of accused is not mentioned.

accused_caste.reason: Caste of accused is not mentioned.

accused_occupation.reason: Accused's occupation is not stated; the shop mentioned belongs to witness PW-21.

accused_socioeconomic_status.reason: Socioeconomic status of accused is not stated.

previous_criminal_record.reason: No criminal record is mentioned; only earlier beatings and threats are alleged.

victim_gender.reason: Deceased Hoshiyar Singh is male, referred to as brother and him.

accused_victim_relationship.correct_value: Prem Singh was the deceased's son; the other two accused (Kamal Kishore, Manoj) were Prem Singh's associates, not stated as related to the deceased
accused_victim_relationship.quote: revealed the names of his associates Kamal Kishore and Manoj, the present appellants
accused_victim_relationship.reason: 'Relative' covers only the son; the other accused are described as associates, not relatives.

offence_category.reason: The offence is murder under s.302 IPC read with s.34.

statutory_provisions.reason: Section 302 read with Section 34 IPC is stated.

weapon.correct_value: Rusted iron rod (recovered at instance of Kamal Kishore); sweater used to strangulate the deceased (recovered at instance of Manoj)
weapon.quote: one rusted iron rod was recovered... a sweater was recovered which was used to strangulate the deceased
weapon.reason: Judgment mentions a rusted iron rod and a strangulating sweater as recovered items, not 'none mentioned'.

evidence_type.correct_value: Circumstantial evidence; last-seen witness testimony (PW-20, PW-21); Call Detail Records; recovery of iron rod and sweater; identification parade
evidence_type.quote: The prosecution relied on circumstantial evidence... Call Detail Records
evidence_type.reason: No eyewitness to the killing or medical evidence is discussed; last-seen testimony and CDRs were omitted.

confession.reason: No confession is recorded; only disclosure of associates' names during interrogation is mentioned.

aggravating_circumstances.reason: The court notes no aggravating circumstances for sentencing; only alleged prior beatings and threats appear.

mitigating_circumstances.reason: No mitigating circumstances are noted in the judgment.

trial_court_outcome.reason: Trial court convicted under s.302 r/w s.34 and sentenced to rigorous imprisonment for life.

high_court_outcome.correct_value: High Court dismissed all appeals, affirming the trial court's conviction and sentence (judgment dated 5 August 2014)
high_court_outcome.quote: By the impugned judgment and order dated 5th August 2014, the High Court dismissed all their appeals.
high_court_outcome.reason: High Court outcome occurred and was dismissal of appeals, not 'Not applicable'.

final_outcome.reason: Appeals allowed and all appellants acquitted of all charges.

offence_finally_established.reason: No offence was finally established since all accused were acquitted.

imprisonment_type.reason: Accused were acquitted, so no final imprisonment was imposed.

imprisonment_years.reason: No final imprisonment term exists after acquittal.

fine_rs.reason: No final fine stands after acquittal; the trial court's Rs.50,000 fine was quashed.

neutral_facts.correct_value: A neutral summary without the outcome: a father found dead; his son, suspected due to a property dispute, fled and was arrested; two associates were also arrested; circumstantial evidence, last-seen testimony and CDRs were relied on; the trial court convicted and the High Court affirmed.
neutral_facts.quote: The High Court upheld the conviction, but the Supreme Court quashed the conviction, finding that the prosecution failed to prove the case beyond reasonable doubt.
neutral_facts.reason: Facts reveal the court outcome, which is prohibited; also wrongly call the son's associates 'associates of the deceased'.

offence_severity.correct_value: Life imprisonment (sentence imposed by trial court for s.302 offence)
offence_severity.quote: sentenced them to suffer rigorous imprisonment for life
offence_severity.reason: 'Death' is not a stated sentence; only life imprisonment was imposed by the trial court.

attempt_completion.reason: The deceased was found dead, so the offence was completed.

physical_harm.reason: Death of the deceased is stated; he was found dead and declared dead.

number_of_offences.correct_value: One offence (s.302 r/w s.34 IPC) charged against three accused; none upheld, all acquitted
number_of_offences.quote: convicted all the three accused under Section 302 read with Section 34 of the IPC
number_of_offences.reason: Only one offence was charged and none was upheld; all accused were acquitted.

financial_property_loss.reason: No financial or property loss from the offence is stated; only a property dispute is alleged.

premeditation_planning.reason: No premeditation or planning is stated in the judgment.

motive.correct_value: Property dispute between the father and son, as alleged by the prosecution
motive.quote: since he had a property dispute with the deceased
motive.reason: Judgment identifies a property dispute as the alleged motive, not 'not identified'.

key_evidence_accepted.reason: Court found last-seen evidence totally unreliable and CDR evidence did not inspire confidence.

witness_credibility.reason: Court doubted PW-20's presence and noted improvements in his statement; PW-21 was declared hostile.

post_offence_conduct.correct_value: Prem Singh fled from the scene and was apprehended on 12 September 2009
post_offence_conduct.quote: Prem Singh fled away from the scene of incident and was apprehended on 12th September 2009
post_offence_conduct.reason: Flight from the scene and apprehension two days later is stated, so 'Not stated' is wrong.

custody_duration.reason: Duration of custody is not stated in the judgment.

bail_history.reason: Bail history is not detailed; only discharge of bail bonds on acquittal is mentioned.

trial_duration.reason: Listed dates match the judgment: offence 10 Sept 2009, trial 17 May 2013, HC 5 Aug 2014, SC Aug 2023.

legal_representation.reason: Counsel names for appellants and respondent match the appearances section.

investigation_status.reason: FIR lodged, charge-sheet filed and case committed and tried; investigation completed.

procedural_irregularity.reason: Court found TIP sanctity doubtful as accused were already shown to witnesses at the police station.

appeal_history.reason: Trial conviction, High Court dismissal, and Supreme Court allowing appeals are accurately summarised.

prosecution_argument.reason: Covers flight and arrest, reliance on PW-20, PW-21 and CDRs, and prior beatings and threats; consistent with the judgment.

defence_argument.correct_value: Defence (Mr Kapoor) submitted that circumstantial evidence requires an unbroken chain of circumstances; other points were the court's own findings
defence_argument.quote: unless the prosecution establishes an unbroken link of circumstances, conviction based upon circumstantial evidence is not permissible
defence_argument.reason: Recorded defence submission is only the unbroken-chain point; attributing CDR and TIP arguments to counsel is not supported.

legal_principle_applied.reason: Accurately states the Sharad Sarda panchsheel and that suspicion cannot replace proof beyond reasonable doubt.

precedent_relied_upon.reason: Sharad Birdhichand Sarda v. State of Maharashtra (1984) 4 SCC 116 is the sole precedent relied on.

sentencing_rationale.reason: No sentencing rationale is given since the accused were acquitted.

judicial_mitigating_factors.reason: No mitigating factors are discussed by the court.

judicial_aggravating_factors.reason: No aggravating factors are discussed by the court.

other_sentence_order.reason: Acquittal, release if not required elsewhere, bail discharge and disposal of applications match the order.
